# Airwallex AgentOS

Skills that teach agents to work with Airwallex AgentOS. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [airwallex/airwallex-marketplace](https://github.com/airwallex/airwallex-marketplace), at commit `8775510`.

Bring Airwallex's global financial infrastructure to Claude.

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **Airwallex AgentOS**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **Airwallex AgentOS**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install airwallex-agentos@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

5 skills: `awx-best-practices`, `beneficiary-creation`, `card-provisioning`, `contract-to-billing`, `manage-cashflow`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

It ships no scripts. The skills are guidance for the agent.

Five skills link to a plugin-level `references/feedback.md` that is not part of this plugin, so those links do not resolve. The skill files are unchanged.
